title: Rate limiting in 60 seconds
caption: Rate limiting in 60 seconds: how an API stays up when one client sends far too many requests. #api #backend #webdev

scenes.title: Rate limiting
scenes.say: One script can hit your API thousands of times a second. Meet the bouncer.
scenes.sub: One script can hit your API thousands of times a second. Meet the bouncer.

scenes.say: One runaway script can send thousands of requests a second, and take an API down for everyone.
A common fix is the token bucket.

items.title: Bucket
items.say: Each client gets a bucket of tokens.

items.title: Refill
items.say: Tokens drip back at a steady rate, so short bursts are fine.

scenes.say: When the bucket's empty, the API answers four twenty nine, too many requests, and says when to try again.
That's rate limiting. A fair share for everyone.
